metric: Pairs of models whose copies are the same logic or a drifted version (other literal, extra filter or column) found by exact plus near-duplicate analysis; a pair from different families counts as wrong.
correctness: Unsafe suggestions are counted under Shared-model refactors, not here; labels checked by execution as for exact copies
held_out: Held-out families (90): 97.5% precision, 99.4% recall. Fresh seed (600 models): see docs
caveats: Similar logic over the same table and join but from another generated family counts as a false pair, which understates precision. Near-only recall (drift pairs the exact check misses) is 74.7%; the repeated-work report scores 89.7% precision, 97.2% recall. Tuned on seed 1.
analysis: Near-duplicate pairs only: 83.5% precision, 74.7% recall; repeated-work report: 89.7% / 97.2%
performance: 3,000 models: exact 18 s, near-duplicates 77 s, repeated work 8 s, refactor verification 64 s (600 models: 4 s, 6 s, 2 s, 14 s)
